hook.description: Verbatim spoken line and/or on-screen text in the first 3 seconds. Copy exactly. null if there is neither speech nor text overlay in the first 3 seconds.

transcript.description: Verbatim spoken words in order, exactly as said. Do not summarize, correct grammar, or translate. null if no speech.

on_screen_text.description: Every distinct text overlay, verbatim, in the order it appears. Empty array if none.

structure.description: The video's beats in order, one entry per beat, 3-6 words each, lowercase, e.g. ["hook question", "personal anecdote", "reveal", "one-line takeaway"]. Describe the shape, not the content.

sentence_pattern.description: 3-6 lowercase words on rhythm, e.g. "short declarative sentences, one clause each" or "long run-on sentences, trailing off".

dialogue_mode.description: How the words are delivered. Pick "other" only if none of the listed values fit.

pacing_cues.description: Qualitative pacing observations only — never measured cut timing. Lowercase phrases, e.g. "long pause before punchline", "rapid-fire list, no pauses". Empty array if nothing notable.

signoff.description: Verbatim closing line or CTA. The literal string "none" if there is no closing line.
